name: superflux-labs
description: Runnable Superflux agent skill labs and proof artifacts.

scripts.test: npm run test:explore-unknowns && npm run test:write-through-problems && npm run test:cognitive-render && npm run test:explaining-with-html && npm run test:sf-learning
scripts.validate: npm run test && npm run validate:catalog && npm run validate:explore-unknowns && npm run validate:write-through-problems
scripts.validate:catalog: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('catalog/skills.json','utf8')); if (!Array.isArray(data.skills)) throw new Error('catalog.skills must be an array'); for (const s of data.skills) { if (!s.name || !s.path || !fs.existsSync(s.path + '/SKILL.md')) throw new Error('invalid skill entry: ' + JSON.stringify(s)); } console.log('catalog validation passed')"
scripts.test:sf-learning: node --test plugins/sf-learning/test/backfill.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/capture-prompt.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/capture.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/classify.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/context.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/iterationReview.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/paths.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/process.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/profile.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/proposalReview.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/propose.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/provenance.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/redact.test.mjs plugins/sf-learning/test/rescore.test.mjs
